pages.text: $(o)A giant iron fist that guards an arena of black stone in the Nether.$()$(br2)$(l)Counter:$() Its punches explode where they land, and it fires a beam when it opens. Strike the eye while it is open.$(br2)Never stand where it is about to punch.
$(l)Defeated.$()$(br2)Its $(item)Gauntlet Core$() counts for the quest book.
